purpose: Teach: カフカ/スマトラ/フィレンツェ/朝鮮日報/ヤコブ/パシフィック/トリビア/バッジ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがカフカの変身を愛読された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Father loved reading Kafka's Metamorphosis.
lines.style: Gentle, remembering tone. Soft opening. Slow cadence as if tracing an old memory. Warm but slightly distant, like speaking to someone not quite in the room.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、スマトラ島出張のお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and didn't Grandfather tell us stories about his business trip to Sumatra, dear?
lines.style: Bright, gently redirecting. Affectionate lilt on the question. A little insistent in her warmth—kindly steering him back to shared ground. Full of small-town certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフィレンツェへの新婚旅行を望まれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Father dreamed of a honeymoon in Florence.
lines.style: Quiet, almost wistful yearning in the voice. A pause before the destination—as if seeing it clearly. Slow, deliberate. The kind of gentle sadness that comes with time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、朝鮮日報の社説を読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't Grandfather always read the editorials in the Chosun Ilbo, dear?
lines.style: Insistent warmth, gently persistent. A slight lift at the end, inviting agreement. She's holding onto something—a small shared certainty in the fog. Her voice steady and sure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがヤコブの梯子の話を聖書から教えて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Father taught me the story of Jacob's Ladder from the Bible.
lines.style: Reverent, quiet opening. The name "Jacob" held with care. Slow, meditative pace. A voice passing down something sacred, almost to himself. Trailing gently into memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、パシフィックリーグの試合を楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't Grandfather love watching the Pacific League games, dear?
lines.style: Warm but reaching. A little more effort in the brightness now. She's trying to anchor him somewhere solid. Her voice full of both love and quiet worry—holding on.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがトリビア知識を披露された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Father would show off his knowledge of all sorts of things.
lines.style: Soft, almost amused remembrance. A quiet warmth underneath. The pacing gentle and unhurried. Voice fades slightly at the end—drifting further into the past, reaching for what he can still hold.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様のバッジを大切に保管されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't you keep our grandchild's badge safe, so carefully, dear?
lines.style: Tender, almost pleading brightness. Full of love and recognition. Voice steady but warm, like she's naming something true between them. A gentle affirmation. Slight warmth on 'you'—bringing him back.
